name: Kisan Call Center (KCC) - Govt of India
description: Toll-free nationwide agricultural hotline providing instant expert advice on crop diseases, pest management, soil health, fertilizer dosing, and market prices in 22 local languages.

name: ICAR Plant Pathology & Crop Protection Advisory
description: Dedicated specialist helpline operated by Indian Council of Agricultural Research scientists for diagnosing mystery crop leaf wilt, fungal epidemics, and pest outbreaks.

name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) District Emergency Network
description: Connect directly to your local district KVK extension officer for field visit requests, soil testing kit pick-up, bio-fertilizer supply, and localized crop advisories.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Crop Loss Claim Hotline
description: Toll-free helpline to report localized crop loss, severe hail/flood damage within 72 hours for immediate crop insurance surveyor inspection.
